tls-server.comment: A TLS server can be used on the attacker box to receive the data.
tls-server.code:
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -days 365 -nodes
openssl s_server -quiet -key key.pem -cert cert.pem -port 12345 >/path/to/output-file

prerequisites: The `zsh` binary must be installed and available to the executing Agent.
The operator must start and control the documented counterpart infrastructure separately.
